correctness.rationale: For every ordered placement x<y with l,m,r old parameters, the proof classifies unary gap states, excludes precisely intersecting x<a<y witnesses for incomparable pairs, and partitions the comparable case into disjoint no-A/no-D, A-present, and D-present classes. Transitivity is proved sufficient from the absence of any old-to-old two-step path. The exact per-placement formulas J and H are summed over l+m+r=n and both variable orientations. Geometric-series algebra yields the exact closed forms and leading coefficients for all n>=0. An independent direct relation-enumeration program verified every placement through n=5, and exact gap sums through n=40; these checks are finite corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Parameter-relative pair-type profiles are canonical orbit counts of the homogeneous linear extension of the random partial order. Exact all-n comparable/incomparable formulas reveal a nontrivial 3/7 limit, distinct from the pure random poset limit 1/2, and give a 7/6 pair-to-squared-unary ratio. Both capture the effect of enforcing the auxiliary linear extension, not merely an isolated finite number or routine index substitution. The structural transitivity case split is reusable for other fixed-arity ordered extensions. No unproved higher-arity statement is claimed.
